launches.title: Corsair: Connect your users to their apps
launches.tagline: 10k GitHub stars, 200+ integrations: Open-source integration layer for agents and product UIs.
launches.body:
Corsair is a fully-featured product integration platform with a seamless DX. Build anything, from an agent working across all your integrations to a multi-tenant dashboard for your users to connect to anything.

[Website](https://corsair.dev) | [Discord](https://discord.gg/uNgCP3mSzU) | [X](https://x.com/corsairdotdev) | [Cal](https://cal.com/dev-jain-ar3ec6/15min)

Most agent integration tools are MCP-only. **Corsair is built on a REST API**, so the same layer works for agents, backend jobs, and the dashboards your customers actually use.

Closed integration platforms keep your users' tokens on infrastructure you can't inspect or leave. **Corsair is open source**. Self-host it, or use Corsair Hub if you want us to handle OAuth and webhooks. Your data remains yours either way.

The more third-party APIs your product touches, the more glue code you write. **Corsair gives every integration the same syntax**, and we maintain the adapters behind it.

**Here's how we use Corsair internally**: a GitHub clone wired up through the Corsair SDK. The UI was vibe-coded in an afternoon. All of it runs on the Corsair SDK.

<https://youtu.be/fflIzDutxsc>

**How we can help you**: If you're stuck writing integrations or your current provider holds your customers' data on servers you don't control, reach out. We'll help you set up Corsair, open a Slack channel for support, and build any integrations you're missing.

[Get started at corsair.dev →](https://corsair.dev)
